A1.justification: Both PDFs describe Flexible Realignment of Language Models and contain readable main text and Appendices A-F. Their methods, equations, figures, tables, and supplementary material can be reliably matched.

before.justification: Sections 4-5 and Appendices E-F report original TrRa/InRa experiments, benchmark scores, efficiency measurements, ablations, and case studies.

after.justification: V2 retains the original reasoning and dialogue experiments, layer-adapter analyses, and supplementary empirical results, including Tables 1-14.

M1.justification: Section 3 retains the same TrRa distillation objective, iterative realignment procedure, identity-initialized bottom-layer adapter, and inference-time logit interpolation.

E1.justification: Training data and task coverage are unchanged: OpenR1-Math-220K, UltraChat-200k, and UltraFeedback remain, alongside the same reasoning and dialogue benchmarks. Appendix F also retains MMLU, CMMLU, GSM8K, TruthfulQA, and the same dialogue and thinking scenarios.

E2.justification: Corresponding comparisons retain the same participants: DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B and DeepScaleR-1.5B-Preview in Table 1; SFT, full DPO, and DeRa in Table 2; and full fine-tuning and LoRA ranks 8 and 128 in Tables 5-6 and 13.

E3.justification: Sections 4-5 and Appendices E-F retain the same preprocessing, model sizes, training budgets, metrics, and evaluation procedures. Examples include 200-step TrRa training, the 16,384-token reasoning generation limit, and the dialogue decoding and judging settings.

E4.justification: Section 5 retains the layer-position, initialization, adapter-count, and hyperparameter analyses. Appendices E-F preserve the learning curves, alignment-tax tests, inference-time switching experiment, embedding visualization, and case studies.

E5.justification: Both versions report averaging eight generations per reasoning example in Section 4.1. Seed and repeated-run disclosures are unchanged, and neither version adds confidence intervals or significance tests.

E6.justification: Tables 1-14, the result figures, and the case-study outputs retain the same values and findings. For example, Table 1 still reports 54.63% token reduction for TrRa-iter1 at lambda = 2.0 and 33.86% for DeepScaleR-1.5B-Preview.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions and derivations in Section 2, the objective in Equation 6, Proposition 1 in Appendix C, and Theorem 1 in Appendix D are unchanged. Punctuation and spacing edits do not alter the mathematics.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same contributions and claims about flexible training-time and inference-time realignment, efficient reasoning, and adjustable 3H alignment.

C2.justification: Interpretations concerning alignment tax, extrapolation, and layer significance remain unchanged. Appendix A retains the doubled KV-cache limitation, possible throughput reduction, and the same proposed future directions.

D1.justification: V1's front-page link to the Hugging Face model collection is omitted in v2. The code repository address remains in a footnote, and implementation details in Appendix E are unchanged. This changes documented access information without establishing any change in actual model availability.

R1.justification: The same 44 references and Section 6 positioning are retained, including the relationships to LoRA, progressive layer expansion, DeRa, and WSPO. The new funding acknowledgments do not change research positioning.

P1.justification: V2 makes small wording and punctuation edits, corrects 'Conclution' to 'Conclusion', updates affiliation and corresponding-author information, and adds funding acknowledgments. The scientific narrative and section organization remain substantially unchanged.

P2.justification: Figure 1 moves from page 1 to page 2 without changing its image or caption, reflowing the introduction. Front-page formatting changes and the funding block shifts reference placement; the remaining figures and tables retain their content and organization.

improvement.justification: The methods, empirical evidence, theoretical material, and limitations remain unchanged throughout the main text and appendices. Small editorial corrections and funding disclosure improve polish and transparency, while omission of the direct model link slightly reduces artifact discoverability. These limited changes do not materially alter the paper's overall quality.
